title: Whale with sparkly eyes
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='whale' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#5aa9e6'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#2d6fb0'/>

    <linearGradient id='belly' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>

      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#9fc9ea'/>

    <radialGradient id='sparkle' cx='0.5' cy='0.5' r='0.5'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#ffffff'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#ffe98a'/>

  <circle cx='36' cy='44' r='6' fill='#1b3f66'/>
